firstTranscript.name: Night Court, The Anaconda Empress, Drum-Belly, White Noise

lines.text: 🚨 Night Court, The Anaconda Empress, Drum-Belly, White Noise is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Night Court, The Anaconda Empress, Drum-Belly, White Noise at the door, day 12.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Step off the line — When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are.
🛡️ Greta, Karima, Yingluck and Pavel met them at the door — 4 driven off. Greta, Karima are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — Night Court, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "We've been thinking. You know things we don't. Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3). We will watch very closely, which is our entire personality."
★ IDENTIFIED: Piquiarana. Tasty fruit, dangerous pit. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.
Brendan was watching. Now they know Piquiarana too.
📚 Village knowledge: Pavel taught everyone about Piquiarana. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 Yingluck makes rounds — Greta gets bound up properly. (28 → 43 HP)
Fireside lesson: Greta passes around Strychnine Tree. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Nathan: "Jewelweed is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🤢 Valeria's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
Adaeze and Karima lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Yingluck peeks into the pantry, then turns the foraging party back. "Plenty for days. Teaching the kids snares instead — they'll need to know."
🍽️ Adaeze leaves the surplus by the fire for whoever's hungry. "The pantry can't take it. We can."
— DAY 13 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Piquiarana — named and noted.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
Two eyes, forward-facing, unblinking. No wingsound. Owls don't make sound when they hunt — that's the problem.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The absence of sound, shaped like wings. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ NIGHT COURT! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
The moon-shadow is growing under you. Silent dive. MOVE.
Spent, wings dragging — it takes the hit badly. (+50% while grounded)
You STRIKE the owl for 20.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 Adjournment!
Owl's Adjournment hits you for 18.
It lands on its kill — wings mantling, head turned too far. It stands there, breathing. Grounded.
📖 Codex: Adjournment — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
Spent, wings dragging — it takes the hit badly. (+50% while grounded)
owl is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the owl for 17.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
It stands in the dirt, wings dragging, head still turned too far. SPENT. Now.
You STRIKE the owl for 18.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
It blinks — once, slowly — and the night takes it back. Gone, upward.
It's high overhead — out of your hands reach. Watch the shadow, not the owl.
The moon-shadow is growing under you. Silent dive. MOVE.
Spent, wings dragging — it takes the hit badly. (+50% while grounded)
The Night Court falls.
📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
You STRIKE the owl for 18.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
📺 +20 style — dropped the Night Court!

Owl. Tastes like chicken that judged you first. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You clutch your Seed packet, Boot stone, Trail compass, Dispatcher's headset, Home key. You're still here. The resonance deepens. (bond 60)
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Elena — 💧 Fetch water. Elena nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.

🌿 Greta checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~14 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Greta hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (124 logs now.)
💧 Brendan returns with 8L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
💧 Elena returns with 6L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Elena telling Priya about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
Adaeze showed Nathan the Daylily Bud — "remember it." Word gets around.
Pavel showed Karima the Piquiarana — "remember it." Word gets around.
💧 Brendan returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 Priya returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 Valeria returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 Nathan returns with water: +4 clean.
Brendan is feeding the fire one stick at a time, watching the flame take.
📖 Priya is walking Pavel through the dusty-green diamond leaves with white mealy underside, grows in disturbed soil — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
Pavel is sweeping the hall. Someone has to.
Nathan is sweeping the corners out, muttering at the dust.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💧 Brendan eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the wood run instead.
🪵 Brendan hauls back 7 wood. The pile grows. (131 logs now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Elena telling Karima about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
You catch fragments by the fire — Pavel telling Priya about Ella. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — Valeria telling Adaeze about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — Elena telling Pavel about Adaeze. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Pavel telling Karima about Elena. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
Priya showed Elena the Daylily Bud — "remember it." Word gets around.
🧭 Elena is back from the west. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Elena stands up by the fire. "Nobody's saying it, so I will: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can bind the wounds, or go lean, or hunt hard to replace what we lost. Say which — standing here isn't an answer."
"Or we rally," Elena adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Codex: Elena proposed relief (raid), day 13.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
🪨 Brendan pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (22 stone now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Valeria telling Adaeze about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — everyone's talking about it now.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Elena is calling it "The Bailiff." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.
